Do not silently lose existing stacked-PR behavior: explicit PR requests asking for stacked or follow-up work must still pass the source PR as base_pr through centralized, tested deterministic logic rather than workflow-shell parsing or a model call. Remove obsolete metadata response plumbing and timeout/model requirements only where they are no longer used. Add focused unit and workflow-envelope tests for title derivation, fallback/truncation, request preservation, source linking, stacked and independent PR requests, and proof that explicit non-issue /implement runs no metadata agent session. Update matching lifecycle and supported-workflow documentation. Do not implement approval-offer, Task 1c, general provider/runtime lazy-install restructuring, or other Task 3 work.
